hymns.searchText: wo neta naa? 239 wo no neta naa, wo hwala wo lemelwa naa? yesu uri ida kha nne awela. dzintho dzi a nkokodzela kha murena naa? milenzheni na kha zwanda dzi hone na i hone khare i ne ya munakisa? ee! i hone ya vhutungu ha mipfa. nda mu toda nda tevhela ndi do wana ni? u tambula vvhuleme na zwililo. nda farelela kha ene ndi do wana ni? ndi awela seli ha yorodane. ndi tshi ri a ntanganedze u do hana naa? naho zwothe zwi tshi fhira ndo linga. ndo fhatutshedzwa naa, ndi a mutevhela naa? ngei seli vhakhethwa vha ri ee, amen. wo neta naa? 239

hymns.searchText: mudzimu, wo vha u thuso yashu 256 mudzimu, wo vha u thuso, u do di ri thusa, u dzhavhelo madumbuni, haya hashu ndiawe! tsini ha khulunoni yau ri do awela; tshanda tshau ndi tshihulu, tshia ri pilela. u vha u hone dzithavha dzi saathu u sikwa, u a tshila, u dzula u hone misi yothe. tshigidi tsha minwaha tshi nga duvha kha iwe, zwi pfana na mutsho u re mupfufhi nga maanda. khotsi, u thuso tsha kale, ro u fulufhela, ri thuse ri kha di tshila, u vhe haya hashu. mudzimu, wo vha u thuso yashu 256

lines: Mudzimu, Wo vha U thuso, U do di ri thusa,
U dzhavhelo madumbuni, Haya hashu ndiawe!
Tsini ha khulunoni yau ri do awela;
Tshanda tshau ndi tshihulu, Tshia ri pilela.
U vha U hone dzithavha dzi saathu u sikwa,
U a tshila, U dzula U hone misi yothe.
Tshigidi tsha minwaha tshi nga duvha kha Iwe,
Zwi pfana na mutsho u re mupfufhi nga Maanda.
Khotsi, U thuso tsha kale, Ro u fulufhela,
Ri thuse ri kha di tshila, U vhe haya hashu.

hymns.title: Mudzimu, Wo Vha U Thuso Yashu

hymns.searchText: wo ima sa thavha khethwa 257 wo ima sa thavha khethwa, wo khwatha sa thavha, muthu a fulufhela ramaanda u do kunda. mitsheto na dzithavha a zwi koni u thusa, sa hoyo ane zwanda zwawe zwa thusa vhothe. ita zwivhya, mudzimu, kha vha no u khoda, vha no nambatela ngoho, vha pfa mulayo wau. wo ima sa thavha khethwa 257

lines: Wo ima sa thavha khethwa, Wo khwatha sa thavha,
Muthu a fulufhela RaMaanda u do kunda.
Mitsheto na dzithavha a zwi koni u thusa,
Sa hoyo ane zwanda zwawe zwa thusa vhothe.
Ita zwivhya, Mudzimu, kha vha no u khoda,
Vha no nambatela ngoho, Vha pfa mulayo wau.
